scope: Read-only anonymous HTTPS verification of published KnaBa TEST v8 against the final native Sites build.
authentication: No cookies, credentials, identity headers or conversation tokens supplied; no session spoofing.
transport: Node 24 --use-env-proxy, normal configured HTTPS proxy with approval-reviewed network access.

api.d1Read: SELECT id FROM profiles LIMIT 1; no row content returned or logged
Published public reviews SELECT and COUNT; contents not recorded
SELECT published_json,published_version FROM studio_pages WHERE page_path=?; public entries not recorded

limits: No browser or rendered interaction verification.
No POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE, sign-in, messages, form submission, provider calls, database mutation or authenticated private-content queries.
GET API results are reduced to schemas, booleans and counts; names, emails, IDs, text, draft/history contents and headers carrying credentials are never persisted.
Exact HTTP response-body hashes compare decoded transfer bytes with built files; request/response compression is not a content difference.
Non-HTML static resources remain served by the hosting platform; their bodies and MIME are checked, but application-owned header policy is required on HTML only.
